comment: The embed operator, end to end. Reads a csv of text, calls the infer server's embeddings endpoint once per row, and writes the vector back onto the row. Added 2026-08-20 at L.3 of the agentic_ai Phase 2 plan, to close the half of criterion 33 that unit tests structurally cannot: the operator's tests run against an httptest stand in, so nothing until now had exercised the builder registration, the config validator, the DAG build and a live /api/embed call together. The input is 500 parts of the cpipes fragment library, whose vectors were also taken directly from the api at L.3a - so the output can be diffed against them rather than merely inspected.

channels.comment: The input file's own columns are taken from the file, here adding the augmented columns only.
channels.name: input_row

apply.comment: vector_column is the whole configuration of the mapping: the vector lives at embeddings.0 and nowhere else, so the operator synthesizes that mapping and this file never names a response path. vector_as_rdf_type is deliberately unset, so the vector lands as json text - which is what a csv cell can carry. The typed-array path is not exercised here and is not claimed to work.

output_mapping.comment: Both envelope values the endpoint returns beyond the vector. model_name proves the response envelope was parsed and not merely the vector plucked out of it; prompt_eval_count is the only token count an embeddings call produces, and reading it here is what shows Tokens() returning (n, 0) is right rather than a lucky zero.
